summary: Large avalanche (~D3) in the East Vail Chutes backcountry outside Vail Mountain's ski boundary caught 4 skiers at ~11:30 a.m. on an east aspect near treeline; Anthony "Tony" Seibert, 24 (grandson of Vail founder Pete Seibert), killed and 3 companions injured (non-life-threatening), extracted Tuesday afternoon
location: East Vail Chutes, outside Vail Mountain ski boundary
notes: CAIC rated the area CONSIDERABLE that morning ("Large triggered avalanche East Vail, east aspect near treeline. 4 Caught, SAR in progress"); second Colorado avalanche fatality of the season UN East Vail Chutes account (1 dead, 3 injured) merged run 540. [merge run-605: KVNF page corroborates same incident] run-724 merge: travelerstoday corroboration (names Anthony Seibert, 24; 3 injured survivors; slide ~11:35 a.m.) | Merged 2026-09-17 (run 852, Vail Daily chunk): realvail.com ECSO-release repost corroboration URL appended (parent-opened; confirms Seibert, East Vail Chutes 2014-01-07, VMRG/ECSO/HAATS response).
